corrections.source_title: Négy szlovák népdal / Quattro canti popolari slovacchi
corrections.correction: Four Slovak Folksongs, mixed choir and piano: current BB77/Sz69; modern BB78/Sz70 is a different set, Slovak Folksongs for male choir
Current HUN-REN Bartók Archives catalogue BB122/Sz115a; arrangement of orchestral Suite No.2 op.4 BB40/Sz34. Keep Sz34a raw as source variant but DO NOT promote as corrected Sz number.
Author's composition posthumously completed with final seventeen bars orchestrated by Tibor Serly; do not ascribe entire concerto to Serly
